thread:
Priya: Heads-up — premium customers in APAC hit fallbacks to EU yesterday during the 11:12–11:20 window. Saw 1200ms p95 uplifts when the region switch happened. We should revisit the weighted-latency threshold logic so tiers don't flip regions too eagerly. :thinking:

Ashley: Ack. I pulled traces — it looks like the probe penalty pushed them over the edge because our penalty multiplier is 2.5 for pro tier. p50 stayed fine but p95 jumped. Sending a quick dashboard link: https://console/redwood/obs/routing?range=1h

Kai: Can you paste the policy snippet? I want to see the ordering of checks (latency vs quota vs affinity).

Priya: Sure — current simplified policy we had in rollout: 

```yaml
priority_checks:
  - affinity_score
  - latency_probe_score # weighted by region_penalty_multiplier
  - remaining_quota

region_penalty_multiplier:
  default: 1.0
  pro: 2.5
  enterprise: 0.8
```

Priya: The idea was to make pro customers more conservative so they avoid degraded regions, but it backfired because transient probe spikes downgrade preferred region too fast.

Liam: Two quick options: (A) add hysteresis window so a region needs N consecutive probes over threshold before switching, or (B) use a soft threshold that decays over time instead of multiplier hard-cut. I'm leaning hysteresis.

Ashley: +1 for hysteresis. Also we should factor in model-variant compatibility — when fallback region doesn't have the same quantized variant, we currently switch to the cheaper variant without notifying the route. For pro customers that's noisy. We could add "variant_match_required" per tier.

Kai: Agreed. For rollout UX we can expose a per-tenant toggle: prefer_latency_over_variant (bool) so CS can opt in. Default for pro = false (require variant match).

infra-bot: alert: routing.probe.spike detected for region-apac1 at 1961111300, duration 600s, avg_probe=430ms

Priya: For telemetry/alerts: let's add a metric that counts "forced_variant_switches" by tenant tier + region. We need an alert when pro tenants get >5 forced switches in 1h.

Liam: Also add an event in the trace when variant fallback happens: {"fallback_reason": "variant_mismatch" | "capacity" | "latency"}. That will help repro.

Ashley: For config change, proposed patch: hysteresis=3 probes, decay_window=300s, add variant_match_required for tiers, and lower pro multiplier to 1.5 while we observe. I can open a PR and a canary rollout across 10% of pro tenants.

Priya: Sounds good. One more UX ask: in the Console route page show "current_region" + "last_region_switch_ts" + "last_fallback_reason" so SRE/CS can quickly see what happened. Kai can you add a mockup? :rocket:

Kai: I'll draft a small mock. Will include an inline timeline and the forced_variant_switches counter.

Priya: Thanks. Action items: Ashley PR for config + canary, Kai mockup, Liam add telemetry events, Priya to update alerts and schedule a 30-min post-canary sync.

Ashley: Opening PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/842

Liam: I'll add the event schema to the tracing proto and a quick generator to emit the JSON in dev env.

Priya: Great — target to deploy the canary tomorrow during low traffic window. Will post time in #eng-oncall once set.

Ashley: thanks all :thumbsup:
